title: Scaffold bajan Rust CLI skeleton
description:
Cargo project like genesis: clap CLI, thiserror, suite JSON envelope output (genesis git dependency, envelope module), module stubs per the three lint-clean specs: specs/ingestion-contract.md, specs/extraction-claims.md, specs/graph-model.md. Stubs: ingest, extract, resolve, query (linking is specced in extraction-claims/graph-model, not a separate module).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (Must gate):
- cargo build + test + clippy -- -D warnings all clean
- Meter: bajan version --json | jq '.ok' -> true (suite envelope, envelope_version 0.1)
- Envelope error path exercised by at least one stub subcommand (Invariant 3.2.5: remediation non-empty)
- Every src file carries a Purpose/Responsibilities/Rationale header (file-headers convention)
- Cargo.toml uses genesis as a git dependency (github.com/charly-vibes/genesis)
- Regression: cargo test stays green at close

ANTI-GOALS: no extraction logic, no storage engine wiring beyond types, no schema beyond gm_schema_v1 stubs, no graph DB.
TYPE: AFK.

title: Create openspec change proposal for bajan KG pipeline
description:
Design the core pipeline per knowledge-graphs-report.md best practices: schema-first extraction config, deterministic ingestion (episodes), LLM extraction behind a trait (only for prose-only facts), entity resolution via embeddings, provenance as graph structure (edge metadata -> episode nodes, merge keeps all parents, invalid_at on mutation), SQLite triple store (no graph DB), deletion as graph walk. Proposal in openspec/changes/.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (Must gate):
- openspec/changes/<id>/proposal.md, design.md, and tasks.md exist and cover all seven practices above, each traceable to a report section
- openspec validate --strict passes (Meter: openspec validate <id> --strict)
- proposal explicitly states what is NOT built in MVP (anti-goal): no graph DB, no LLM in the ingestion path for structure that already exists (report §3/§4)

TYPE: HITL — proposal requires human approval before implementation issues are filed.
close_reason: superseded — design captured as specodelic specs (specs/ingestion-contract.md, specs/graph-model.md) instead of an openspec proposal; behavior oracle remains the EARS spec

title: Author eval.claims spec — extraction precision/recall harness
description:
Consume the ex_output_schema extension point (specs/extraction-claims.md): spec the claim-extraction eval harness. Golden-file corpora with known source counts N (p_reified generators), precision/recall meter for candidate claims, hedge-preservation checks (gm_hedge_anchor), and the eval-before-adoption discipline from knowledge-graphs-report.md §4.6/§7.4 — the report's Gaps section flags that nobody publishes extraction quality numbers; bajan should. Eval results are checked into the repo (evals/results.md) as the decision artifact for storage-stack choices (keep SQLite vs earn a graph DB).
